components.name: Composer
components.description: Raised prompt box with mode tabs, ghost controls, model select and send; the working segment travels its top edge while the agent runs.
components.css: .ds-composer { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; width: 480px; padding: 10px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--bg-elevated, #111112); box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.9); transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-composer:focus-within::before { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); } .ds-running::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 14px; right: 14px; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--text-secondary, #bdbdc2) 50%, transparent); background-size: 35% 100%; background-repeat: no-repeat; animation: ds-work 1.6s cubic-bezier(0.45,0,0.55,1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-work { from { background-position: -40% 0; } to { background-position: 140% 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-running::after { animation: none; } } .ds-composer-top { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-tab { height: 24px; padding: 0 9px; border-radius: 6px; border: 0; background: none; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-muted, #85858b); cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--text-secondary, #bdbdc2); } .ds-tab.ds-on { color: var(--text-heading, #f5f5f6); background: var(--bg-active, rgba(255,255,255,0.075)); } .ds-composer-input { border: 0; outline: none; resize: none; background: transparent; padding: 4px 7px; font: 14px/1.5 inherit; color: var(--text-primary, #e6e6e8); caret-color: var(--accent-blue, #4c8dff); } .ds-composer-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-ctl, .ds-model { height: 30px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 8px; border: 0; background: none; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-secondary, #bdbdc2); cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-ctl:hover, .ds-model:hover { background: var(--bg-hover, rgba(255,255,255,0.055)); color: var(--text-primary, #e6e6e8); } .ds-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent-green, #4ade80); } .ds-send { width: 32px; height: 32px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 8px; border: 0; color: var(--text-faint, #7f7f85); background: var(--bg-active, rgba(255,255,255,0.075)); cursor: pointer; } .ds-send.ds-ready { color: var(--bg-root, #000); background: var(--text-heading, #f5f5f6); } .ds-tab:focus-visible, .ds-ctl:focus-visible, .ds-model:focus-visible, .ds-send:focus-visible { outline: 1.5px solid var(--accent-blue, #4c8dff); narrative.overview:
Sorvex Desktop is a tool used for hours beside an editor and a terminal, so the system is built to recede. The canvas is true black, the chrome (icon rail and sessions sidebar) sits one step above it as a single dark band, and raised surfaces (composer, menus, dialogs, user turns, the changed-files card) sit one more step up. Separation comes from 1px white hairlines at 6-16% opacity, not from fills, glows or shadows. Text carries the hierarchy through a six-step grey ink ladder; the agent's reply, in near-white body type, is the brightest thing in view.

Density is high but legible: 12-13px controls, 14px body, rows of 26-36px, tight 4-12px gaps. One accent, the logo blue, marks focus, caret, text selection, switches, links and the active marker in a provider rail. Primary actions are not blue; they are solid near-white on black. Other hues appear only to carry state (plan violet, security red, added green, warning amber), and almost always as text or a hairline tint rather than a fill.

Motion is nearly absent. Hovers ease colour and background over 0.12-0.15s. The one ambient movement in the product is the working segment: while the agent runs, a short bright segment travels along the composer's top hairline. Reduced motion stops it. A light theme mirrors every token on a #fbfbfb canvas and must keep working.
keyCharacteristics: True-black canvas, chrome one step up, raised surfaces one more step up.
Hierarchy through grey ink steps, not weight or colour.
One blue accent for focus and selection; primary buttons are solid near-white.
State hues as text or tinted hairlines only.
One moving thing: the working segment on the composer edge.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Blue means "this is where your input goes or what you picked": focus, caret, selection, on-switch, link. A blue button, blue card, or blue icon at rest is off-system.

rules.name: The Near-White Primary Rule
rules.body: The primary action (send when ready, setup confirm, dialog confirm) is solid `ink-heading` on `canvas` text, hover mixing 14% toward black. In light theme it inverts to near-black on white.

rules.name: The State-As-Text Rule
rules.body: Mode and status hues colour text, an icon, or a hairline (at ~40% mix). Fills, when used, stay at 8-15% tint behind text of the same hue.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Literal Rule
rules.body: Mono is reserved for values the machine produced or will read: paths, code, counts, commands. UI copy is never set in mono.

rules.name: The Grey-Not-Bold Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy steps down the ink ladder before it steps up in weight. 600 is for dialog and card titles; everything else is 400-500. No uppercase, no tracking-out on labels.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Durations, percentages, counts, context sizes and shortcuts use tabular numerals so they don't jitter as they change.

rules.name: The Hairline-First Rule
rules.body: If a surface needs separating, add a 1px hairline before reaching for a fill change or a shadow. Cards and rows at rest have no shadow.

rules.name: The One Mover Rule
rules.body: The working segment on the composer's top edge (35% wide gradient, 1.6s, `cubic-bezier(0.45, 0, 0.55, 1)`, infinite) is the only ambient animation. Progress bars and a pulsing record ring are functional exceptions; everything else is a 0.12-0.15s state transition.

dos: Do separate regions with 1px hairlines (`hairline-subtle` for dividers, `hairline` for controls, `hairline-overlay` for floating surfaces).
Do keep the canvas `#000`, chrome `#0a0a0b`, raised `#111112`; add depth by stepping surfaces, not by adding shadows.
Do make the primary action solid near-white on black, and reserve blue for focus, caret, selection, switches and links.
Do carry mode and status as coloured text or a ~40% hairline tint; when a fill is needed, an 8-15% tint behind same-hue text.
Do set paths, code, counts and commands in JetBrains Mono, with tabular numerals for anything that changes.
Do use hairline-separated rows for lists of choices (starters, checklists, skills) instead of a card per item.
Do honour `prefers-reduced-motion` for the working segment and pulse.
Do define every new colour in both `:root` and `:root.theme-light`.
donts: Don't add glowing or gradient borders; the only gradient on an edge is the working segment, and only while the agent runs.
Don't fill buttons, cards or chips with the accent blue.
Don't add a second ambient animation; state transitions stay at 0.12-0.15s.
Don't use a logo hero or suggestion cards for empty states; the empty state is a question, a path and plain starter rows.
Don't set UI copy in uppercase or with letter-spacing, and don't place small labels above headings.
Don't use colours outside the token set; reference the custom properties.
